headline: Oman Economy Forecast to Grow 4.1% in 2026 Amid Regional Expansion
summary: Oman's real GDP is projected to expand by 4.1% this year, outperforming several neighboring Gulf Cooperation Council economies that face growth contractions.
why: Oman is a Middle Eastern oil exporter undergoing structural fiscal reforms under its Vision 2040 economic diversification plan.

impacts.name: Oman
impacts.why: Higher oil revenues and industrial output bolster national economic output relative to regional peers.
